breakdown.description: Thermal expansion coefficient beta for an ideal gas is approximately 1/T in absolute units (Kelvin); using Celsius temperature in beta = 1/T is incorrect.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'T_C will be expressed in Kelvin when calculating beta,' which corrects the original error of using Celsius. This aligns with the ground truth's requirement that beta = 1/T_abs be evaluated at the film temperature in Kelvin.
